The Problem

Sourcing from China Shouldn't Be This Hard

You've got products to sell. But between language barriers, quality issues, and shipping headaches, sourcing from China feels like a full-time job. We get it — and we fix it.

Language Barrier

You don't speak Mandarin. Most suppliers don't speak English. Miscommunication costs you time and money.

We negotiate in Mandarin, report in English.

Quality Risk

Photos look perfect online. The actual shipment arrives with defects, wrong colors, or missing parts.

100% inspection before shipping, with photo proof.

MOQ Pressure

You need 100 pieces. The factory demands 5,000. Small buyers get priced out or ignored entirely.

Low MOQ access + order consolidation.

Shipping Chaos

Who handles customs? Which freight is cheapest? Will your goods actually arrive? It's a black box.

Door-to-door DDP shipping with tracking.
What We Do

End-to-End Sourcing Services

From finding the right supplier to delivering goods to your door — we handle every step so you don't have to.

01

Product Sourcing

We search Yiwu Market, 1688, and verified factories to find the best products at the lowest prices.

  • Free sample coordination
02

Quality Inspection

Every order is inspected before shipment. We catch problems so you don't have to deal with returns.

  • Pre-production sample verification
  • Final pre-shipment 100% check
  • Detailed photo & video reports
  • Defect replacement at no cost to you
03

Warehousing & Consolidation

Buy from 10 different suppliers? We collect everything in our warehouse and ship it as one container.

  • Free 30-day storage in Yiwu warehouse
  • Multi-supplier order consolidation
  • Professional repacking & labeling
  • Save up to 60% on shipping costs
04

Shipping & Customs

Sea, air, or express — we choose the best route for your budget and timeline, with full customs handling.

  • Door-to-door DDP service

05

Private Label & OEM

Build your brand with custom logos, packaging, and product modifications. We manage the entire OEM process.

  • Custom logo printing & engraving

Payment Protection

Your money is safe. We hold payment until goods pass inspection, then release to suppliers.

  • Secure company bank account
  • Escrow-style payment protection
  • PayPal / T/T / Western Union
  • Transparent invoicing

Why Herman Sourcing

We're Not Just Agents — We're Your Logistics Partner in Yiwu

Anyone can forward an email. What sets us apart is deep expertise in both product sourcing and international logistics — we optimize your entire supply chain, not just one step.

Logistics & Consolidation Experts

We don't just find products — we optimize your shipping. By consolidating multiple suppliers into one shipment, our clients save an average of 40-60% on freight costs. We handle sea, air, and express with DDP customs clearance.

5 Years, 100+ Categories

From electronics to home goods, beauty to auto parts — we've sourced across nearly every category in Yiwu Market. This breadth means we know which suppliers are reliable, which are overpriced, and where the real deals are.

Direct Communication, No Middlemen

You work directly with Herman — no account managers, no ticket systems, no runaround. English communication, WhatsApp replies within hours, and honest advice even when it means telling you a product isn't worth sourcing.

The Herman Sourcing Guarantee — Zero-Risk Inspections

Every order is inspected before shipping, and you receive photo & video proof. If the goods don't match your approved sample, we get them replaced at no cost to you — or we refund your deposit in full. That's our promise, in writing.

Applies to orders placed through Herman Sourcing. Claims must be made within 7 days of receiving your inspection report, based on comparison with your approved sample.
